battle.name: 大廈谷戰爭
battle.brief: 大廈谷戰爭於1932年4月在大廈谷及帕里一帶爆發，英屬印度遠征隊與中國軍隊共同面對西藏軍隊，衝突集中於邊境據點與山區陣地。英軍步兵體系中的恩菲爾德步槍（Enfield rifle）於1858年列裝，屬制式單兵步槍，負責射擊、警戒與伴隨步兵作戰，並為步兵分隊提供基礎火力。

kit.name: 恩菲爾德步槍
kit.history: 恩菲爾德步槍是英國陸軍早期制式步槍，配置於步兵連，負責單兵射擊、警戒及隨軍作戰，是步兵分隊的重要火力。

countries: 大廈谷戰爭（Damxung War）是民國二十一年（1932）中華民國與拉薩方面之間的一場邊境戰役。主要接觸集中於大廈谷，以及由此通往拉薩、黑河的山口通道，康藏邊境的前哨也同時受到牽制。中方作戰主力不是南京直屬的單一師，而是劉文輝掌握的西康軍系統與馬步芳掌握的青海軍，分別在東、北兩個方向部署；藏方則由拉薩政府調集沿途駐軍與機動兵力。戰役始於1932年的調兵、前進與前哨接觸，經數次攻守及補給線爭奪，最後以中方退回中國境內的側翼地區告終。這是一場有明確戰役高潮的區域戰事，不能與1939年的康藏戰鬥或1950年解放西藏混為一談。
countriesEn: The Damxung War was a frontier campaign fought in 1932 between forces of the Republic of China and the authorities in Lhasa. The principal contact took place around the Damxung valley and along the mountain routes connecting it with Lhasa and Nagqu, while outposts farther toward the Kham–Tibet frontier were also affected. The Chinese field effort was not a single division directly controlled from Nanjing, but consisted principally of Liu Wenhui’s Xikang military system and Ma Bufang’s Qinghai forces, deployed toward the eastern and northern approaches respectively. On the Tibetan side, the Lhasa administration drew upon garrisons along the route and mobile troops from the interior. The campaign began with mobilization, forward movement, and contact between outposts in 1932, continued through several attacks, counterattacks, and struggles over supply lines, and ended with the Chinese forces withdrawing to the adjacent regions of China. It was a regional campaign with a distinct operational climax, not to be confused with the fighting in Kham in 1939 or the Chinese entry into Tibet in 1950.
people: 南京方面雖以軍事委員會與參謀系統決定入藏作戰，真正調兵者則是控制西康與青海的劉文輝、馬步芳。劉文輝以二十四軍系統為西康方面的主要骨幹，青海軍隊則在北線配合，兩集團的指揮距離、補給來源和作戰目標並不完全一致。藏方政治上由十三世達賴喇嘛時期的拉薩政府處理，攝政 Reting Rinpoche 掌握中央軍政；前線則常見 Ngao Ngawang Jigme 與 Tsarong Dasang Dadul 等核心軍政人物的名字。不同回憶對二人何時在前線、誰主持中央調度，以及各支隊的番號記載不一，因此較可靠的寫法是分別列出曾經主持或參與作戰的人，而不要硬把每道命令歸給單一指揮官。
peopleEn: The military authorities in Nanjing authorized the campaign, but the actual mobilization was carried out by Liu Wenhui and Ma Bufang, who controlled Xikang and Qinghai respectively. Liu’s principal formation was the system built around the 24th Army, while Qinghai troops operated on the northern approach; the two commands did not share identical command distances, supply systems, or operational aims. On the Tibetan side, political and military affairs were handled by the Lhasa government during the reign of the 13th Dalai Lama, with Regent Reting Rinpoche directing central military administration. Ngao Ngawang Jigme and Tsarong Dasang Dadul are the names most frequently associated with operations in the field. Since accounts differ over who was at the front, who handled central coordination, and the designations of particular detachments, the safest record identifies those who did command or participate without assigning every order to a single commander.
kits: 可由1932年前的軍制與中英武器來源核對的常見配備，包括中方二十四軍等部隊使用的二十四式漢陽步槍、ZB-26輕機槍、Maxim MG 08/30水冷重機槍，以及七五式山炮和1931年才列裝的八八式步兵砲；前兩種步槍與機槍主要使用7.92×57公厘彈藥，後兩種火炮分別使用七五及八八公厘砲彈。藏軍常見英製李－恩菲爾德SMLE Mk III步槍、維克斯水冷重機槍和英國在二十世紀初供應的QF 75公厘野戰炮，對應的常用槍彈為.303英制。兩軍並非所有單位都配齊同一套武器，砲位、彈藥和備用件亦分散於不同後方據點。由於道路只勉強可供馬匹、騾子及有限車輛通行，遠距 artillery 與大量彈藥主要依靠分段馱運，前線缺藥往往比槍口故障更早決定攻勢。
kitsEn: The common equipment identifiable from pre-1932 orders of battle and the Chinese and British sources included the Chinese Type 24 Hanyuan rifle, ZB-26 light machine gun, Maxim MG 08/30 water-cooled heavy machine gun, Type 75 mountain gun, and Type 88 infantry gun, the last having entered service in 1931. The rifles and machine guns used 7.92×57 mm ammunition, while the two artillery types used 75 mm and 88 mm ammunition. Tibetan forces commonly relied on the British Lee-Enfield SMLE Mk III rifle, the Vickers water-cooled heavy machine gun, and British QF 75 mm field guns supplied during the early twentieth century, with .303 inch ammunition for the British weapons. Not every unit possessed a complete set of these weapons, and guns, ammunition, and spare parts were distributed among separate supporting positions. Because the roads were little more than tracks suitable for horses, mules, and a limited number of vehicles, the longer-range guns and bulk ammunition moved in relayed pack transport. A shortage at the front was therefore likely to result from an inadequate supply chain before it resulted from a weapon mechanically failing.
tactics: 部署完成後，西康方面的縱隊主要沿東側邊境山道向內推進，青海方向的隊伍則由黑河至大廈谷的交通線接近。中方縱隊以步兵為核心，把機槍連、輕型火炮、彈藥車列與馬匹馱運隊分開配置；接近山口後，先設砲位、偵察道路，再以步兵攻取兩側高地。藏軍沒有沿整條交通線逐點硬阻，而是以機動分隊封鎖隘口，控制可俯瞰谷地的山脊，並保留一支能迅速轉向側後的力量。接觸初期，中方曾取得部分道路、營地與彈藥庫，但每次正面攻擊都受到高地火力和側翼威脅。藏軍轉用集中砲火封鎖縱隊道路，再以騎兵及輕裝步兵切斷輸送線，使中方前進部隊與後方砲隊逐漸脫節；補給受阻後，中方先以小規模試探掩護退路，最後分批退出谷地。
tacticsEn: After the deployment was completed, Xikang columns generally advanced inward along mountain tracks on the eastern frontier, while the Qinghai force approached along the route connecting Nagqu with Damxung. Chinese columns were organized around infantry, with machine-gun sections, light artillery, ammunition trains, and pack transport kept at different distances behind. On reaching a pass, the troops established gun positions, reconnoitred the track, and then used infantry to seize the heights on either side. The Tibetans did not attempt to block every point along the route in a rigid line. Mobile detachments sealed the passes, held ridges commanding the valley, and retained forces capable of moving rapidly against a flank or rear. In the initial phase, the Chinese gained some roads, camps, and ammunition depots, but each frontal assault met fire from the heights and threats from the side. The Tibetans then concentrated artillery against the advancing roads and used cavalry and lightly equipped infantry to cut the transport line, gradually separating the leading infantry from the guns and supply columns behind it. Once the line was interrupted, smaller Chinese probes covered the withdrawal, and the force withdrew from the valley in stages.
data: 現有中英文資料足以確定三個時間節點：1930年英國武裝使團進入西藏並在江孜建立商務機構；1932年初南京方面的西康與青海軍完成第一批調兵，前沿接觸隨即發生；主力戰鬥延續數月，至1932年結束以前，中方隊伍退出大廈谷戰區。資料對首批部隊何日完成部署、某次側擊應歸入交戰初期還是撤退階段，記載並不一致；部分中英文資料又以達巴、Damxung等拼法互見，使同一批戰鬥有時被拆成數個事件。因而較嚴謹的年表只保留部署、主戰鬥、補給崩解與撤退四個階段，不把缺乏共同紀年的局部戰報硬配成精確日期。各方傷亡總數同樣互相矛盾，也沒有足以交叉核驗的完整名冊，所以只能確認雙方均有重大損失，不能寫出一個表面精確而來源不明的死亡數。
dataEn: The surviving Chinese and English records establish three dependable chronological points. In 1930, a British armed expedition entered Tibet and established a commercial agency at Gyantse. In early 1932, the first Xikang and Qinghai formations completed their initial mobilization and contact at the forward positions followed soon afterward. The main fighting continued for several months, and before the end of 1932 the Chinese troops had withdrawn from the Damxung operational area. The sources do not agree on the exact date on which the leading units completed deployment or whether a particular flanking action belongs to the opening phase or the withdrawal. Chinese and English accounts also alternate between transliterations such as Daba and Damxung, sometimes dividing one engagement into several separately reported actions. The sounder chronology therefore retains four stages—deployment, main battle, breakdown of supply, and withdrawal—without forcing poorly dated local reports into an exact day. The casualty totals are equally contradictory, and no complete surviving roster permits reliable verification. It is possible to state that both sides suffered substantial losses, but not to give a falsely precise death toll without a defensible source.
cause: 大廈谷衝突有國際與國內兩層背景。1930年 Frederick William Gould 率領的英國武裝使團進入西藏，並在江孜設置商務機構，使南京方面對西藏邊防及英方影響更加敏感；然而現有證據不能證明英國策動了1932年的戰爭，英國也不是作戰方。直接原因仍是中藏邊界控制線上的軍事接觸：劉文輝、馬步芳所部向前沿駐地推進後，藏軍將其視為進入自己實際控制的區域並要求退兵，中方則把藏軍的集結和阻截視為抗拒中央管轄。長期背景則是中華民國不承認西藏的實際獨立地位，而拉薩政權依其軍政與邊防體系行使管治；地方軍政首長又希望藉軍事行動擴大邊地影響與資源控制。戰爭因此既有中央主權與地方實權的衝突，也有兩地軍隊為邊界據點和交通線而進行的直接角力。
causeEn: The Damxung conflict had both an international and a domestic background. In 1930, an armed British expedition led by Frederick William Gould entered Tibet and established a commercial agency at Gyantse. This deepened Nanjing’s concern over Tibet’s frontier defenses and possible British influence, although the surviving evidence does not show that Britain instigated the war in 1932, and Britain was not a belligerent. The immediate cause was nevertheless a military collision along the contested line of frontier control. After the forces of Liu Wenhui and Ma Bufang advanced toward forward positions, the Tibetans regarded the movement as an entry into territory under their effective administration and demanded a withdrawal, while the Chinese authorities treated Tibetan concentration and obstruction as resistance to central authority. The longer background was the Republic of China’s refusal to recognize Tibet’s de facto independence, contrasted with the exercise of actual authority by the Lhasa administration through its military and frontier system. Local commanders also sought to enlarge their influence and control of strategic routes and resources. The war therefore combined a conflict between central claims and local power with a direct contest by two regional armies over frontier positions and lines of communication.
impact: 大廈谷戰役的轉折並非某一發砲彈或某一次正面突擊，而是中方補給體系逐步失去作用。中方初期憑藉步槍、機槍與火炮的火力優勢，確實取得部分道路和陣地，卻無法同時壓制所有山脊；藏軍則利用較短的內部供應線，讓砲位隨側翼威脅轉移，並以機動兵力攻擊道路與縱隊之間的薄弱環節。當馬匹馱運的彈藥無法跟上 infantry，遠程砲又因道路堵塞不能取得射界，中方每次推進都增加被切斷的風險。藏軍同樣付出傷亡，並非毫無代價地取得勝利；但從戰役經過看，藏方較能維持攻勢主動權，中方則被迫由局部進攻轉為分批撤退。這場結果強化了大廈谷一帶由藏軍控制的實際局面，提高藏方日後談判與維持邊防的籌碼；南京方面則沒有因此放棄其對西藏地位的法律與政治主張。
impactEn: The turning point at Damxung was not a single shell or frontal assault, but the progressive failure of the Chinese supply system. With advantages in rifles, machine guns, and artillery, the Chinese initially seized some roads and positions, yet they could not suppress every ridge at once. The Tibetans used shorter internal supply routes, shifted gun positions in response to threats against their flanks, and used mobile forces to strike the vulnerable links between roads and marching columns. Once pack-borne ammunition could no longer keep pace with the infantry and blocked roads prevented the longer-range guns from obtaining firing positions, every further Chinese advance increased the risk of isolation. The Tibetans also suffered losses and did not win without cost, but they retained the initiative more effectively, while the Chinese were forced to convert a local advance into an orderly withdrawal. The outcome reinforced Tibetan military control around Damxung and strengthened the Lhasa administration’s position in later negotiations and frontier defense. It did not, however, cause Nanjing to abandon its political and legal claims concerning Tibet’s status.
result: 中方在主力戰鬥失利、補給線被切斷後，陸續把部隊與作戰物資撤回西康及青海方向；部分前沿哨所、帳棚、彈藥和難以運出的火炮被放棄或落入藏軍之手。藏軍重新占領大廈谷及若干接近山口的據點，但沒有把戰役擴大成深入西康或青海的遠征，雙方最後回到大廈谷戰鬥前大致相近的分界狀態，也沒有因這一役立即建立永久性的邊界條約。一般戰史把結果列為藏軍的戰術及作戰勝利，而中方仍保留原有政治主張，這兩點並不矛盾。傷亡數字因雙方紀錄、真實殘骸與被俘名冊均不完整，無法可靠給出精確總數；最可確認的結果，是中方退出大廈谷、藏方保有該地區，以及此後數年邊境相對維持在衝突前後的界線附近。
resultEn: After the main engagement turned against them and their supply line was cut, the Chinese forces withdrew in stages toward Xikang and Qinghai. Some forward posts, tents, ammunition, and guns that could not be moved were abandoned or fell into Tibetan hands. The Tibetans reoccupied Damxung and several nearby positions overlooking the approaches, but they did not transform the campaign into a deep invasion of Xikang or Qinghai. The two sides ultimately returned to a division broadly similar to that preceding the Damxung fighting, and the battle did not immediately produce a permanent boundary treaty. General military histories consequently classify the result as a Tibetan tactical and operational victory, while the Chinese authorities retained their existing political claim; the two conclusions are compatible. Precise casualty totals cannot be established because neither side’s surviving records, physical remains, and prisoner records are complete. The firmly supportable outcome is that the Chinese withdrew, the Tibetans retained Damxung, and the frontier remained close to the approximate line that had existed before the conflict for several years.
